newsitem.title: USA: Nortech Forest Tech trims FY96 loss.
newsitem.headline: Nortech Forest Tech trims FY96 loss.

text.p: Nortech Forest Technologies Inc said Thursday its loss for fiscal 1996 was substantially lower than the loss on 1995 thanks to higher sales and gross profit and lower operating expenses.
The company reported a net loss of $163,795, or $0.12 a share, compared to a loss of $542,950, or $0.51 a share, in fiscal 1995.
Sales rose to $205,154 from $112,333, while gross profit climbed to $121,313 from $59,000, Nortech said. Operating expenses fell to $435,423 from $591,774, Nortech said.
Nortech makes and markets tree-growth-related products for consumers and forestry professionals.
